name: Suntimes Calendars
tagline: A calendar provider add-on for Suntimes.
blurb: Provides calendar events for the solstices, equinoxes, twilight periods (astronomical, nautical, civil (sunrise, sunset)), and the moon (moonrise, moonset, major phases, apogee, perigee).
description:
Provides calendar events for the solstices, equinoxes, twilight periods (astronomical, nautical, civil (sunrise, sunset)), and the moon (moonrise, moonset, major phases, apogee, perigee).

This add-on for Suntimes provides events to your Calendar app. It can also can save events to .ics for use in other apps. It depends on Suntimes v0.10.3 or later.

The following permissions are required:
* WRITE_SYNC_SETTINGS is used to create and add custom calendars to the Calendar app.
* WRITE_CALENDAR is used to populate custom calendars with events.
* suntimes.permission.READ_CALCULATOR is used to read data from the Suntimes provider.
